inputs.text: A former Israeli prime minister’s adviser, Daniel Rubenstein, says a political resolution is vital, yet the message still centers Israel’s “unwavering stance” against Iran’s nuclear and missile programs and describes the operation as ongoing. That tension matters: lasting security cannot come from military action alone. A political path must address the wider structures driving conflict and put the safety and rights of people across the region ahead of endless escalation.
